tagline: Podcast publishing and listening, plus live or scheduled online radio.
summary: Spoken-audio product concept for podcast publishing and listening, plus live or scheduled online radio.
statusNote: LSI Podcast and Online Radio is a product concept. Nothing has been released.

audiences.name: Listeners
audiences.description: People who want to find shows, follow episodes and tune in to online radio channels.

audiences.name: Creators
audiences.description: Podcasters and broadcasters who want to publish episodes or run a radio channel.

capabilities.name: Podcast shows and episodes
capabilities.description: Set up a show, add its details and publish episodes.

capabilities.name: Online radio channels
capabilities.description: Run a channel with live or scheduled streaming.

capabilities.name: Listening controls
capabilities.description: Play, pause and move through episodes and live streams.

capabilities.name: Creator analytics
capabilities.description: See how shows and channels are performing.

capabilities.name: Sharing
capabilities.description: Share shows, episodes and channels with other people.

capabilities.name: Offline listening
capabilities.description: Save episodes to listen without a connection.

requirements.label: Account
requirements.detail: Not confirmed yet. Creators are expected to need an account to publish.

gettingStarted: There is nothing to install or open yet. Listener and creator setup steps will be published before launch.
limitations: This is a product concept. Every capability on this page is planned, not available.
Upload formats, file limits, scheduling rules and the moderation and publishing workflow will be specified before launch.
